summary: Connect project stages to indicators, data checks and evaluation decisions. Explore the five-day M&E training outline and course outcomes.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation across a project lifecycle connects evidence to decisions from design through closeout. This intermediate course is for project managers, M&E officers and programme quality specialists who need to build that connection in practice. You will map responsibilities by project stage, define indicators and baselines using Theory of Change and Logframe methods, create an M&E plan, check data quality in an Excel tracker, and frame evaluation questions to guide review and action.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who already work with project plans or results information and need to connect M&E tasks to design, implementation, review and closeout decisions.
audience: Project Managers using results data to address
outcomes: Indicator Design And Data Quality Assessment
modules: Theory of Change and Assumption Mapping
Project Review Brief and Learning Record
prerequisites: Working familiarity with project plans or results reporting is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel available; no additional software installation or personal platform account is required. Practice files are used during exercises.
